title: A Volcano Was Heard 3,000 Miles Away. It Burst Eardrums

scenes.text: In 1883, a volcano exploded and was heard 3,000 miles away.
Krakatoa blew up on August 27th, and people on an island near Mauritius heard it as gunfire.
Sailors forty miles away had their eardrums burst.
The shock wave raced around the planet, circling it more than three times.
Weather instruments around the world picked it up.
The tsunamis killed more than 36,000 people.

description:
In 1883, Krakatoa exploded and was heard 3,000 miles away.
It burst the eardrums of sailors forty miles out, and its pressure wave circled the Earth more than three times.
Could you imagine hearing a sound from that far away?
first_comment: What is the loudest thing you have ever heard?
